monitored_text: Help Center Help Center Aluminum CNC Machining Aluminum 7075 CNC Machining Help Center Ordering CNC Machining Ordering Sheet Metal Ordering CNC Machining Materials Aluminum CNC Machining Copper CNC Machining Plastic CNC Machining Stainless Steel CNC Machining Steel Alloy CNC Machining Sheet Metal Materials Aluminum Stainless Steel Alloy Steel CNC Machining Tutorials CNC Machining Design CNC Machining Knowledge Sheet Metal Tutorials Sheet Metal Design CNC Machine Basic Knowledge 5-Axis CNC Machine Privacy&Policies Coupon Policy Shipping Policies Policies Aluminum 7075 CNC Machining Last updated on Jul 16, 2025 7075 aluminum alloy is a cold-treated forging alloy with high strength, far better than soft steel. 7075 is one of the most powerful alloys for commercial use. 7075 aluminum alloy has a tight structure and strong corrosion resistance and is best for aviation and marine plates. General corrosion resistance, good mechanical properties, and anodic reaction. Fine grains make better depth drilling performance and enhanced tool wear resistance. Mechanical properties Tensile strength σb (MPa): ≥560 Elongation stress σp0.2 (MPa): ≥450 Elongation rate (%): ≥10 Note: Mechanical properties of seamless rob Specimen size: diameter ≥ 70mm Heat treatment The forming properties are better in the state, annealed and newly quenched state and the strengthening effect of heat treatment is significant, but the heat treatment process is strictly required. Corrosion resistance is poor, but can be effectively protected by pure aluminum cladding; easy to produce cracks when welding, but can be welded and riveted using special technology.
